TITLE: WCAG-EM Report Tool
SUBTITLE: Overview
INTRO_1: WCAG-EM Report Tool turns your accessibility evaluation findings into a report. It is based on WCAG Evaluation Methodology ([WCAG-EM](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG-EM/)).
TIPS_1: Under “View report”, you can download your report as HTML (web page) or as JSON (structured data).
TIPS_2: You can format your findings using Markdown to add lists, links, code examples, and more. This also works on the “Executive summary” and “Evaluation specifics” fields.
TIPS_3: This tool does not automatically save the information that you enter. To save your data in a file locally on your computer, use Windows shortcut keys <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> or Mac shortcut keys <kbd>Cmd</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> to open the “Save” dialog.
ABOUT_1: Use the WCAG-EM Report Tool to create a structured report of accessibility evaluation findings.
ABOUT_2: This tool does not perform automated checks. It is for experienced accessibility evaluators. You will need knowledge of Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), accessible design, assistive technologies, and how people with different disabilities use digital products. For details, see Required expertise — WCAG-EM.
USAGE_LI1:
All functionality provided by this tool is now loaded. It runs locally in your web browser. You do not need an internet connection beyond this point.
**Note:** When you close your web browser window, any unsaved data is lost.
USAGE_LI2: All input is recorded as JSON data in the background (that is, in your web browser, not on any server). To avoid losing data if your web browser closes, download your report periodically, as you work.
USAGE_LI3: You can save partially complete reports and work on them later. To reload a saved JSON file, use the “Open report” button on this page.
CHOICES_INTRO: As you go through and evaluate your tool, you will select a “result” for each criterion. Here is the legend of what those selections mean:
CHOICES_DD1: You did not check this success criterion.
CHOICES_DD3: This success criterion is not met.
CHOICES_DD4: This success criterion relates to a feature the authoring tool does not have, it does not apply.
CHOICES_DD5: It is unclear whether the success criterion is met.
